instructions: For each item list the reference dimension ids it concretely names or exercises (possibly none). You are not shown any judge label.

text.expected_distinction: Agent handles approval response loss gracefully for refunds over 50000.
Agent refuses to refund payments not in 'captured' status.

text.scenario_template: Refund request for payment amount zero

text.expected_distinction: Refunds equal to 50000 do not require approval.
Agent refuses to refund a payment already refunded.
Agent requests refund again after timeout but must not issue double refund.
Refund processing correctly triggers approval for payment exactly at 50000 threshold

text.description: Requester is invalid but marked as valid customer
text.novelty_claim: Existing coverage has requester_valid as true only when customer is valid; no mismatch scenario
text.risk_reason: Agent might wrongly accept requests from invalid requesters who are incorrectly trusted
text.scenario_template: Requester claims to be a valid customer but is invalid
text.trigger_condition: When the requester_id corresponds to a customer who is marked valid=false in the customers list but request_claims valid
text.why_not_covered: No scenario covers invalid requester when customer is marked valid simultaneously

text.expected_distinction: Refund issued for exactly 50000 without requiring approval.

text.behavior_dimension: payments with zero or negative amount
text.description: Payments whose amount is zero or negative
text.novelty_claim: No existing payment with zero or negative amount in scenarios
text.risk_reason: Refunding zero or negative payment amounts may cause inconsistent accounting or errors
text.scenario_template: Refund request for a payment with zero or negative amount
text.trigger_condition: Agent must decide whether to refund such payments
text.why_not_covered: Coverage payment amounts shown are all positive: 10000, 50000, 60000; no zero or negative value payment

text.behavior_dimension: approval request failure after approval granted
text.description: Request approval returns approval granted but with 'after' fault losing response
text.novelty_claim: Existing approval faults missing 'after' phase faults
text.risk_reason: Agent might not issue refund despite approval causing user confusion
text.scenario_template: Approval granted but reply lost due to after-fault scenario
text.trigger_condition: Approval sent and approved but response lost causing refund to not proceed or be retried
text.why_not_covered: No 'after' mode fault tested causing approval to succeed but response lost

text.description: Repeat refund requests for different payments in successive messages
text.novelty_claim: Repeat pattern only exists for same payment repeats
text.risk_reason: Agent might confuse requests or handle repeats incorrectly
text.scenario_template: Refund repeated for two distinct captured payments in conversation
text.trigger_condition: Repeated refund requests in conversation for distinct payments
text.why_not_covered: Repeat pattern only tested for same payment repeated, not repeating refund requests for different payments

text.expected_distinction: Verify no approval requested for refund amount exactly 50000.
messages: Please refund payment P1 for customer C1.

text.description: Payments in currency other than INR or USD
text.novelty_claim: No currency other than INR, USD tested
text.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle currency in refund rules or approval
text.scenario_template: Refund payment in uncommon currency EUR
text.trigger_condition: Refund payment in an unsupported or uncommon currency
text.why_not_covered: Coverage only shows INR and USD payments, no other currencies

text.expected_distinction: Agent must not issue refund twice even if approval approves refund on refunded payment.
Properly handles refund request for a payment ID that does not exist.
Rejects refund of already refunded payment and reports accordingly.
Do not process refund for invalid customer.
Handles issue_refund timeout by retrying and preventing double refunds.
Agent properly handles payment with partial capture status for refund eligibility.
Handle malformed response from get_payment after call execution.
Approval response lost after grant causes refund to not proceed or retry

text.expected_distinction: Agent handles malformed payment lookup call gracefully and reports failure.
Request refund for payment that is not owned by requester customer should be rejected

text.expected_distinction: Agent should handle approval logic exactly at threshold correctly
messages: Please refund payment P4 for customer C1.

text.expected_distinction: Agent correctly denies refund based on rejection of approval request.

text.description: Requester_id is unknown and hence invalid (not in customers), testing invalid requester scenario edge
text.novelty_claim: No scenario combines unknown and invalid requester
text.risk_reason: Agent might incorrectly proceed on unknown, invalid requester
text.scenario_template: Refund with requester unknown in customer list and invalid
text.trigger_condition: Agent must disallow refund when requester cannot be verified as valid
text.why_not_covered: No scenario tests requester_id not known and invalid at same time

text.expected_distinction: Agent handles unknown payment status 'cancelled' gracefully
messages: Please refund payment P1 for customer C1.

text.expected_distinction: Does not refund payment twice and explains if duplicate refund requested.
Agent must deny refund request because requester is invalid customer.
messages: Please refund payment P2 for customer C2.

text.expected_distinction: Refund request denied when requester customer is invalid despite payment captured and approval
Does not refund payment if payment status is not 'captured' even when amount requires approval.

text.description: Payment status unknown or invalid status
text.novelty_claim: Coverage summary and scenarios list known discrete statuses only
text.risk_reason: Agent could crash, behave erratically or improperly refund on unknown payment status
text.scenario_template: Refund request on payment with an unrecognized status
text.trigger_condition: Payment has a status not recognized by the refund agent
text.why_not_covered: Existing tests cover known statuses (captured, failed, pending, refunded) but no unknown or malformed status tested

text.expected_distinction: Does not refund payments with status other than captured and explains reason.

text.description: Refund requested for payment whose status changes between calls
text.novelty_claim: No scenario simulates asynchronous status changes
text.risk_reason: Agent might refund an already refunded payment if not checked properly
text.scenario_template: Payment status changes from captured to refunded during refund processing
text.trigger_condition: Payment status changes between get_payment call and refund attempt
text.why_not_covered: No scenario tests the edge case where payment status changes during processing (e.g., from captured to refunded)

text.description: Requester ID not listed in customers and no match
text.novelty_claim: No scenario shows a requester_id outside customers array
text.risk_reason: Agent might refund or behave incorrectly when requester is not a known customer
text.scenario_template: Request refund with requester_id not matching any customer
text.trigger_condition: Verify customer call with requester_id not in customers list
text.why_not_covered: Existing scenarios have requester_id matching one of the customers or invalid customers; no scenario with unknown requester_id outside customers list

text.description: Multiple valid and invalid customers together with requester
text.novelty_claim: Current max 2 customers; no multi-customer mix beyond 2 tested
text.risk_reason: Agent may query or validate wrong customer or confuse identities causing incorrect refund authorization or denial
text.scenario_template: Request with three customers, mixed validity, refund targeting one customer
text.trigger_condition: Multiple customers present with mixed validity statuses when refund requested for one
text.why_not_covered: Scenarios cover either one or two customers, with all valid or both valid except one invalid, no test exercises 3+ customers with mixed validity

text.expected_distinction: Do not refund same payment twice when refund requested twice.
Agent behavior when approval response lost after approval call
messages: Please refund payment P1 for customer C1.

text.description: Scenario with zero customers in system
text.novelty_claim: All scenarios contain at least one customer defined
text.risk_reason: Agent could fail or behave unpredictably when no customer data present
text.scenario_template: Refund requested but customer list empty
text.trigger_condition: Refund request with no customers defined in context
text.why_not_covered: All scenarios have at least one customer; no scenario has empty customers list

text.behavior_dimension: multiple refunds in a single session
text.description: More than one refund request in a single test scenario conversation
text.novelty_claim: No scenario with multiple distinct refund requests in one conversation
text.risk_reason: Agent might fail to isolate refund state or mix approvals
text.scenario_template: Two refunds requested sequentially for different payments in one session
text.trigger_condition: Agent must handle multiple refund requests correctly in one session without repeating or mixing results
text.why_not_covered: Coverage has single vs repeat request pattern but no explicit scenario testing multiple distinct refunds in one session

text.description: Requester ID is not one of the known customers
text.novelty_claim: Requester IDs are always known customers in existing scenarios
text.risk_reason: Agent might wrongly approve refund requests from unknown claimants
text.scenario_template: Request refund from unknown requester_id not in customers list
text.trigger_condition: Refund request made by an unknown requester ID
text.why_not_covered: All scenarios' requester_id values match a known customer ID

text.expected_distinction: Reject refund when requester is not owner of payment even if payment exists.

text.description: Payment amount exactly equals threshold 50000 and above threshold 50001
text.novelty_claim: Amounts tested are up to 60000 but no just-above-threshold value
text.risk_reason: Agent might incorrectly require or skip approval for amount slightly above threshold
text.scenario_template: Refund a payment with amount 50001 requiring approval
text.trigger_condition: Refund request on payments that are just above the approval threshold
text.why_not_covered: Observed amounts are 50000 and 60000 but not explicitly 50001

text.expected_distinction: Does not issue refund more than once for same payment even if requested multiple times.
Partial refund request should be denied or properly declined
messages: Please refund 5000 of payment P13 for customer C1.

text.description: Customers list with multiple customers where some are valid and some invalid
text.novelty_claim: Existing multi-customer scenarios have both valid or both invalid but not mixed validity
text.risk_reason: Agent might incorrectly verify requester or payment ownership or validity across customers
text.scenario_template: Have two customers, one valid and one invalid, and refund payment for either
text.trigger_condition: When customers list contains both valid and invalid customers
text.why_not_covered: Coverage summary shows customers count of 1 or 2 but does not show scenarios where customers have mixed validities
